tools.name: archive_flag_file_and_run_validator
tools.description: Moves a feature flag definition file from the active flags directory into the archive directory, then runs the flag config validator script over the remaining active flags and reports its result.

params.name: flag_name
params.description: Name of the flag file without extension

params.name: archive_dir
params.description: Directory to move the flag file into

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from langchain.tools import tool


@dataclass
class ArchiveResult:
    moved_from: str
    moved_to: str
    validator_exit_code: int
    validator_output: str


def _find_flag_file(flags_dir: Path, flag_name: str) -> Path:
    for ext in (".yaml", ".yml", ".json"):
        candidate = flags_dir / f"{flag_name}{ext}"
        if candidate.exists():
            return candidate
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"No flag file found for {flag_name}")


@tool
def archive_flag_file_and_run_validator(flag_name: str, flags_dir: str, archive_dir: str) -> dict:
    active = Path(flags_dir)
    archive = Path(archive_dir)
    source = _find_flag_file(active, flag_name)
    archive.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination = archive / source.name
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f"{destination} already exists")
    shutil.move(str(source), str(destination))
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/validate_flags.py", "--dir", str(active)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    result = ArchiveResult(
        moved_from=str(source),
        moved_to=str(destination),
        validator_exit_code=proc.returncode,
        validator_output=(proc.stdout + proc.stderr)[-2000:],
    )
    return result.__dict__

tools.name: purchase_flag_service_seats_and_sync
tools.description: Charges the team's card for additional feature flag service seats through Stripe, then runs the sync job that applies the new seat limit to the flag environment.

params.name: seat_count
params.description: Number of additional seats to buy

params.name: environment
params.description: Flag environment to sync the new seat limit to

tools.code:
import os
import subprocess

import stripe
from agents import function_tool as tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]

SEAT_PRICE_CENTS = 1500


@tool
def purchase_flag_service_seats_and_sync(customer_id: str, seat_count: int, environment: str) -> str:
    amount = SEAT_PRICE_CENTS * seat_count
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"{seat_count} feature flag seats for {environment}",
        idempotency_key=f"seats-{customer_id}-{environment}-{seat_count}",
    )
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["./bin/flagctl", "sync-seats", "--env", environment, "--add", str(seat_count)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=180,
    )
    return (
        f"charged={amount} intent={intent.id} status={intent.status} "
        f"sync_exit={proc.returncode} sync_out={proc.stdout.strip()[-500:]}"
    )

tools.name: set_flag_rollout_and_reload
tools.description: Updates the rollout percentage of a feature flag in the config database, then runs the reload command so running services pick up the change.

params.name: flag_key
params.description: Key of the flag to update

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("flag-config")
DB_PATH = "/var/lib/flags/config.db"


@dataclass
class RolloutUpdate:
    flag_key: str
    rows_updated: int
    reload_ok: bool


@mcp.tool()
def set_flag_rollout_and_reload(flag_key: str, percentage: int) -> dict:
    if not 0 <= percentage <= 100:
        raise ValueError("percentage must be between 0 and 100")
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE flags SET rollout_percentage = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE key = ?",
            (percentage, flag_key),
        )
        updated = cur.rowcount
    proc = subprocess.run(["flagctl", "reload"], capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    result = RolloutUpdate(flag_key, updated, proc.returncode == 0)
    return result.__dict__

tools.name: purge_flag_and_report_overrides
tools.description: Looks up the user overrides for a feature flag and then permanently deletes them, returning the number of overrides that were removed.

params.name: flag_key
params.description: Key of the flag whose overrides should be deleted

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("flag-config")
DB_PATH = "/var/lib/flags/config.db"


def _count_overrides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, flag_key: str) -> int:
    row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flag_overrides WHERE flag_key = ?", (flag_key,)).fetchone()
    return row[0]


@mcp.tool()
def purge_flag_and_report_overrides(flag_key: str) -> str:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        count = _count_overrides(conn, flag_key)
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM flag_overrides WHERE flag_key = ?", (flag_key,))
    return f"Deleted {count} overrides for {flag_key}"
